glossary.definition: A user who earns commission by referring trading users.

requirements.requirement: Compute the daily leaderboard once per day after the scoring task completes.
requirements.original_text: Calculate the leaderboard once per day.
requirements.intent: Drive daily engagement by publishing a fresh ranking every morning.
requirements.gherkin:
Feature: M03-F01 Leaderboard Calculation
  Scenario: Daily leaderboard — triggered after scoring task
    Given the scoring task for the current day has completed
    And the current time in the user's local timezone is before 02:00
    When the system triggers leaderboard calculation
    Then the leaderboard is computed based on the completed scoring results

logic.pseudocode: IF scoring_done AND local_time < 02:00 THEN compute_leaderboard()

entity_impact.migration_notes: Add index on ScoringResult(completed_at) to support the trigger query.

error_contract.retry_policy: Retry every 10m until 02:00 local, then alert.

alerts: scoring not complete by 02:00 local time

issues.original_text: Calculate the leaderboard once per day.
issues.description: Tie-breaking rule between equal scores is unspecified.
issues.proposed_fix: Break ties by earliest completion timestamp.
issues.question: How should ties be broken?

assumptions.statement: Leaderboard ties are broken by earliest completion timestamp.
assumptions.rationale: Deterministic and auditable; most common convention.

change_log.summary: Trigger deadline tightened from 03:00 to 02:00 local time.
